See how it works

WHY COGUAVA

Good ideas can come
from anyone.

You shouldn’t need Stanford, a startup accelerator, or the right LinkedIn circle to meet your future business partner.

WHO COGUAVA IS FOR

A hairstylist, accountant, parent, engineer, student, or restaurant worker could all be looking for a side business.

Your job title does not determine whether your idea deserves a chance. You may already have the idea, motivation, time, knowledge, or part of the money. You may simply be missing one person who brings the rest.

HAIRSTYLIST ACCOUNTANT PARENT ENGINEER STUDENT RESTAURANT WORKER

THE CORE IDEA

Two people nearby.
One thing they both want to build.

01

Same goal

You both want to open the café, buy the franchise, launch the podcast, or start the company.

02

Different pieces

You bring what you already have. Your match brings what has been keeping the idea from moving forward.

03

Close enough to begin

You might live a few miles apart and never meet without a place designed to bring you together.

MATCH BY INTENTION, NOT PRESTIGE

Your goal matters more
than your résumé.

COGUAVA ASKS

  • What do you want to build?
  • What can you bring?
  • What are you missing?
  • How close should your match be?

COGUAVA DOESN’T REQUIRE

  • An elite school
  • A founder title
  • A perfect career story
  • A polished professional network

SAFETY WITHOUT THE STATUS TEST

Verify the person.
Not their prestige.

CoGuava is designed to verify every member’s identity, phone, email, and live selfie before the profile can appear. LinkedIn and professional history can add context, but they stay optional.

✓ IDENTITY VERIFIED ✓ CONTACT VERIFIED ✓ LOCATION PROTECTED ✓ MUTUAL MATCH ONLY

OUR MISSION

To help every idea find the missing person who can bring it to life.

Find your person ↗
